brief.aim: The table is the Cleveland heart-disease cohort, whose evident aim is predicting angiographic heart-disease status from non-invasive clinical and exercise-test features. Two categorical outcomes encode the same row at different granularity: 'num' (5 ordered grades 0-4) and 'heart_disease_binary' (0 = no disease, 1 = any grade 1-4), where the coarser level is a deterministic function of the finer one. Per the multilabel rule these are joint outcomes, so both are targets rather than one being a leakage suspect of the other. No row key, recurring subject, or chronological column exists, so grouping and time partitions are left empty. primary_metric is left null so the workflow metric applies.
brief.repeated_subjects: No subject/record key column; each row appears to be a distinct patient, so no grouping column is available.
brief.unit: one patient examination record (single row per patient)
